mainEntity.name: Is Help Scout a help desk or a shared inbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is both. Inbox is built around shared conversations, while Workflows, SLAs, Docs, Beacon, and customer profiles add help desk and self-service features.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The current pricing page lists up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site, and 100 contacts per month on Free.

mainEntity.name: Can Help Scout import tickets from another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: The standard import tool supports several providers and can bring in conversations or tickets with customer profiles and tags. It does not import every setting or content type.

mainEntity.name: Is Envoy included in the Help Scout seat price?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Envoy is a separate AI-agent product listed at $0.75 per resolution, with three months of free resolutions for a new account.
